decisions.question: Which LLM client approach should the harness use for the Anthropic provider?
options: anthropic Python SDK (handles streaming, types, retries)
Raw httpx (full control, no vendor SDK)
decisions.resolution: {"action": "select", "selected": "Raw httpx (full control, no vendor SDK) — specifically: custom thin provider abstraction wrapping the anthropic and openai Python SDKs directly. Two ~150-line provider classes (AnthropicProvider, OpenAICompatProvider) implementing a shared Provider interface. No third-party abstraction layer (no LiteLLM, mirascope, etc.). The anthropic and openai SDKs handle streaming/types/retries for their respective APIs, and the thin adapter translates to egg's internal event format."}

decisions.question: Should the MVP include the interactive terminal mode, or focus solely on headless (pipeline) mode first?
options: Both headless and interactive in MVP

decisions.question: Should egg-native tools (EggOrch, EggContract, etc.) be included in MVP, or shell out to CLIs initially?
options: Shell out to CLIs initially (lower risk, faster MVP)
Native Python tool implementations from the start
decisions.resolution: {"action": "select", "selected": "Shell out to CLIs initially (lower risk, faster MVP) — egg-native tools (EggOrch, EggContract, EggCheckpoint, GitOps, GhCli) will call existing CLI scripts via subprocess for MVP. Native Python implementations come incrementally per-tool in follow-up work."}

decisions.question: What should the default harness be during the transition period?
options: Default to claude-sdk, opt-in to egg harness
Default to egg harness, opt-out to claude-sdk
decisions.resolution: {"action": "select", "selected": "Default to claude-sdk, opt-in to egg harness — but make this configurable both via EGG_HARNESS env var AND in PipelineConfig/settings. Default is claude-sdk. When a user with a subscription account selects the egg harness, display a warning that using the egg harness with a Claude subscription account is a TOS violation for the Anthropic subscription. The harness selection should be a first-class config option, not just an env var."}

decisions.question: Are NotebookEdit, WebFetch, WebSearch all required for MVP? Are there unlisted Claude Code tools agents rely on?
decisions.resolution: {"action": "select", "selected": "Include WebFetch and WebSearch in MVP (simple HTTP wrappers, already conditionally disabled in private mode). Defer NotebookEdit — rarely used by pipeline agents. No unlisted Claude Code tools needed — Agent tool delegation is explicitly out of scope per the issue."}

decisions.question: Should transcript capture move from gateway proxy to harness, stay in gateway, or both?
decisions.resolution: {"action": "select", "selected": "Keep transcript capture in the gateway for MVP — it already works and transcripts are not security-sensitive. Can migrate to harness later if needed."}

decisions.question: Cost tracking approach: exact via pricing API or approximate with hardcoded per-model rates?
decisions.resolution: {"action": "select", "selected": "Hardcoded per-model rates for MVP. Anthropic SDK returns token counts; multiply by known rates. No external pricing API dependency."}

decisions.question: Should the harness internalize retry/restart logic or leave it in the consensus wrapper?
decisions.resolution: {"action": "select", "selected": "Leave the full restart-on-exit and BRC recovery logic in the consensus wrapper for MVP, but the harness itself should implement basic retries with exponential backoff for transient API failures (rate limits, 5xx errors, connection resets). This keeps the harness resilient to common API issues without internalizing the full consensus restart semantics."}

decisions.question: CLAUDE.md loading: replicate exact rule-merging from sandbox/agent-config/rules/ or simplify?
decisions.resolution: {"action": "select", "selected": "Replicate the exact rule-merging from sandbox/agent-config/rules/. Agents depend on the combined rule files and simplifying risks behavioral differences."}

decisions.question: Model alias: support opus[1m] max-token suffix syntax or configure max_tokens separately?
decisions.resolution: {"action": "select", "selected": "Support the opus[1m] max-token suffix syntax for backwards compatibility — it is used throughout the codebase. Also support a separate max_tokens config option. The suffix parser takes precedence when present."}

decisions.question: Parallel validation: what metrics to compare and which test pipeline for A/B testing?
decisions.resolution: {"action": "select", "selected": "Compare cost_usd, num_turns, duration_ms, and task success rate. Use a known-good small bug fix issue as the test pipeline. Exact test pipeline TBD when ready for A/B validation."}

decisions.question: Does this MVP need to account for multi-model routing (#1571) or is that post-MVP?
decisions.resolution: {"action": "select", "selected": "Post-MVP — multi-model routing (#1571) is not in scope for this MVP. However, the provider abstraction (ProviderConfig, Provider base class) should be designed so #1571 can layer on top without rewiring."}

decisions.question: The refine phase has completed. Please review the analysis and approve to continue, or provide feedback to request changes.
decisions.context: **Warning**: No analysis draft was found on the work branch. The agent may not have written the output to the expected path.
decisions.resolution: {"action": "approve", "context": "All 12 design decisions resolved. Key choices: custom thin adapter (anthropic + openai SDKs), both headless and interactive in MVP, shell out to CLIs for egg-native tools initially, default claude-sdk with configurable opt-in to egg harness (with TOS warning for subscription accounts). Reviewer suggestion noted: plan phase should address error handling semantics for the agent loop (API errors, malformed tool responses, tool execution crashes)."}
